root: ^Flora is holding her champagne glass with white knuckles.

g-0: ^"Come to gawk at the humiliated noblewoman? I'm not interested in company."

bad_evening_talk: ^She laughs bitterly. "A bad evening? Alistair eviscerated me in front of the entire court. Called me mentally unfit."

g-0: ^"Said I'd be begging in gutters by year's end—all because I refused to marry him."
g-1: ^Her voice shakes. "Do you know what it's like to have your entire legacy threatened by a man's bruised ego?"
g-2: ^"He's filing papers to have me disinherited. My family's name, erased, because I said no."
g-3: ^She stares into the distance. "I actually thought my reputation would protect me. How naive."

step_2: ^"You're not the only one he's hurt tonight."
others_hurt_talk: ^"Oh, I know. Derek's on the chopping block too. And Brooklyn? She's been his prisoner for years, just with nicer chains. Even Gaten—his own puppet—looks miserable."

g-0: ^She turns to you. "But here's what terrifies me: Cornellius. He stands there, smiling, helping Alistair destroy people."
g-1: ^"What kind of man does that? Either he's spineless, or he's playing a game none of us can see."

what_to_do_talk: ^"What can I do? Fight him in court? He owns the judges. Appeal to the King? Gaten's his puppet. Run? He'll find me."

g-0: ^Her voice drops to a whisper. "The only way to stop a man like Alistair is... well."

ending: ^Flora looks down into her glass, the liquid trembling.
